 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. It's another good test for your fighting Ben McCollums as they take on the always formidable Creighton today. I don't know much about this year's version of the Bluejays but first impression seems to suggest that this is a more beatable version than last year's.
 The Hawkeyes are favored by 4.5. It would be really good to get a win here as the Hawkeyes showed some good things against Virginia Tech but also made some big mistakes that cost them the game.
 How to watch:
 Date: Nov 15, 2026 
 Time: 2 p.m. CST
 Matchup: Iowa Hawkeyes vs. Creighton Bluejays
 Location: Casey's Center, Des Moines, IA
 TV: FS1
